entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return a pair of your so-called 'performance' cycling shoes. This is completely unacceptable.
I can certainly look into a return for you. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with the shoes?

What's the issue? The issue is they're torture devices! I went for one ride after putting my cleats on them and they gave me horrible blisters. I can't even pedal! I want a full refund, and I want it now.

I'm very sorry to hear that the fit was so uncomfortable and caused blisters. That's definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Just to confirm, this was a sizing or comfort issue, not a technical fault with the shoe itself?

Are you listening? They don't fit, they hurt, they're garbage! Is that 'technical' enough for you? Stop wasting my time with questions and process my return or I want your manager on the line. I'm one click away from leaving a review that will make sure no one ever buys these things again.
That won't be necessary, sir. I can absolutely process this for you. I just need to verify the purchase date. Can I get your order number or the email address associated with your VeloFit account?
Ugh, fine. The order number is VF88602. Now hurry up.

Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see your order for the cycling shoes, placed 37 days ago. Let me just check the policy... Yes, you're well within our 90-day return window. I've just initiated the return process for you. You'll receive an email with a prepaid shipping label in the next few minutes. Once we receive the item, we will issue a full refund to your original payment method.
Finally. So I just print the label and drop it off?
That's correct. The email will have all the instructions. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No. Just make sure that refund shows up quickly.
We will process it as soon as the return is received. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I do apologize again for the issue with the shoes.
